content.hebrew: אֶזְכּוֹר לְמִצְוַת מֶ־ : לֶךְ רָם וְנַעְלָה
content.transliteration: Ezkor lemitsvat me- : lech ram vena‘la
content.english: I shall recall the commandment of the high and exalted King!

content.hebrew: גָּזַר לְעַם בָּחַר : עִם קוֹל הֲמוּלָּה
content.transliteration: Gazar le‘am baḥar : im ḳol hamulla
content.english: He ordained it for the people He chose, with a tumultuous voice:
“Hallow the Sabbath most willingly!”
Hence, they are called the treasured congregation.
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!
I shall keep the proper time and cease work:

content.hebrew: כִּי בָא זְמַן קֹדֶשׁ : נָגִיל בְּשִֹמְחָה
content.transliteration: Ki va zeman ḳodesh : naḡil besimḥa
content.english: For the sacred time has arrived—let us rejoice.
From the setting of the sun, as ordained,
I shall promptly cease and rest in its shade.
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!
I shall learn from the mouths of the pure people the secret of the day,
Which the Lord of the Universe decreed an eternal remembrance,
And the secret of creation out of nothing:
The One mighty in deed created all existence.
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!
I shall find for my soul rest and repose,
Contemplating the divine law and the benefit of its command:
After the days of labor, a relief to the body,
Because of my rest, gladness and joyous cries!
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!
I shall study the second secret the wise ones devised:

content.hebrew: קִדּוּשׁ שְׁבִיעִי אַ־ : חַר שֵׁשׁ בְּיָמִים
content.transliteration: Ḳiddush shevi‘i a- : ḥar shesh beyamim
content.english: The sanctification of the seventh day after six days,
As is the human soul, it is also sealed knowledge—
Six on its sides; rising upward from them.
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!
I shall hold fast to God’s law and give praise

content.hebrew: עַל מַתְּנַת יוֹם זֶה : יוֹם הַבְּרָכָה
content.english: For the gift of this day, a day of blessing.
Amen, may the Rock fulfill all the promises:
Gather my exiles to the joy of splendor!
Let us receive the perfect bride!

content.hebrew: נֵצֵא לְמוּלָהּ עִם : קוֹל שִׁיר וְגִילָה:
content.english: Let us go towards her with calls of song and joy!

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Boné yerushalayim adonai nidḥé yisra’el yechannes.
content.english: As it is written: Adonai rebuilds Jerusalem; He gathers in the exiles of Israel (Ps. 147:2).
